note: Teams that are the contact for the record of a class (D195). A line of one of the 'checks' on a CI of one of the 'classes' goes to the team, never to the people of the CI: one message to every person of the team (Settings, Requests and mailboxes), nobody copied. Process Management is responsible for the record of a Business Process; its mapping is SACM's work with the process owner (Relationship missing), and SACM does not chase the BIA (the criticality cards).
